name: pancanqtl

relevance.justification: Core BioThings variant/gene/disease/drug entity coverage: eQTL SNP-gene expression associations (RS IDs mapped to genes), SNP-GWAS trait/disease linkage-disequilibrium associations (with PubMed ID provenance), SNP-drug response associations, and SNP-immune cell infiltration associations across 33 TCGA cancer types. Fully structured/tabular (TSV/gzipped text), uses standard identifiers (dbSNP RS IDs, gene symbols, PubMed IDs), and represents genotype-phenotype relationships central to MyVariant.info's scope.

novelty.justification: No cancer-type-specific eQTL, eQTL-GWAS linkage, eQTL-drug-response, or eQTL-immune-infiltration association data found in any existing BioThings API source (checked existing-biothings-plugins.json's myvariant_info source list: ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD, dbNSFP, CADD — none provide expression QTL associations). This is a distinct relation type (variant-to-expression-to-phenotype linkage per cancer type) not redundant with any variant annotation source currently ingested.

openness.justification: All four data modules (Fine-mapping, eQTL-GWAS, Drug-eQTL, Immune-eQTL) are served as direct per-cancer-type .gz static files from hanlaboratory.com/static/PancanQTLv2/Download/ with no login, no API key, and no click-through gate (verified via HTTP HEAD: content-type application/x-gzip, HTTP 200). License is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) per the paper's ali:license_ref, generally compatible with BioThings' academic/non-profit hosting (Su Lab, Scripps Research) per the evaluation checklist's CC-BY-NC guidance (PASS 3/5).

evidence.scope: Cancer-type-specific eQTL (expression quantitative trait loci) resource across 33 TCGA cancer types: (1) fine-mapped causal eQTL credible sets (SuSiE, 25 cancer types with n>100), (2) eQTL linkage associations with GWAS Catalog risk loci, (3) eQTL associations with drug response (from DrVAEN and cancerRxTissue), (4) eQTL associations with immune cell infiltration (from ImmuneCellsGSVA, ImmuCellAI, TIMER, CIBERSORT).
evidence.overlap: No overlap with existing BioThings sources; existing MyVariant.info sources (ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD, dbNSFP, CADD) provide variant annotation/pathogenicity/frequency data but no gene-expression or phenotype-association eQTL data.

api_info.record_coverage: No public REST/GraphQL API found on hanlaboratory.com/PancanQTLv2/ beyond the query-and-download web UI; all data accessed via static per-cancer-type bulk download files.

risks: CC BY-NC 4.0 restricts commercial redistribution; generally acceptable for BioThings/Scripps non-profit hosting but flag for downstream commercial API consumers

eQTL-GWAS module files are large per-cancer-type (BRCA alone is 121 MB gzipped) — full ingestion across 33 cancer types will be a large document volume (paper reports 84,592,135 total GWAS linkage associations)
Site is a Flask/SQLite app on a lab-hosted domain (hanlaboratory.com), not a dedicated database domain — lower long-term stability guarantee than institutionally-hosted resources
No fine-mapping files exist for 8 of 33 cancer types (ACC, CHOL, DLBC, KICH, MESO, READ, UCS, UVM — sample size <=100, excluded from fine-mapping per paper's methods)
